name: plex-exporter
description: See what your Plex server is doing in Grafana: sessions, libraries, bandwidth, transcoding. Connects to your Plex Media Server and exposes metrics (active sessions, library sizes, bandwidth, transcoding status) on /metrics for Prometheus to scrape and Grafana to visualize. A ready-made Grafana dashboard ships in the project repository (grafana-dashboard.json). Read-only against Plex, no web UI of its own.

variables.name: Plex URL
variables.description: Full URL of your Plex Media Server including scheme and port, e.g. http://192.0.2.100:32400

variables.name: Plex Token
variables.description: Plex authentication token of the server administrator (Plex Web: Settings, XML view, myPlexAccessToken)

variables.name: Plex CA certificate path
variables.description: Only for an https Plex URL with a self-signed or private-CA certificate: in-container path of the CA PEM file (add a matching path mapping)
